title: Find the names and artists of all cards that are available only in paper, i
question: Find the names and artists of all cards that are available only in paper, illustrated by either Allen Williams or Adam Rex, have unknown power (either NULL or '*'), and are legal in the Commander format. Additionally, include a flag indicating whether each card is banned in any format.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    T1."XCL_049" AS name,
    T1."XCL_002" AS artist,
    CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM legalities AS T3
            WHERE T3."XCL_086" = T1."XCL_072"
              AND T3."XCL_085" = 'Banned'
        ) THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS is_banned
FROM cards AS T1
WHERE
    T1."XCL_004" = 'paper'
    AND T1."XCL_002" IN ('Allen Williams', 'Adam Rex')
    AND (T1."XCL_055" IS NULL OR T1."XCL_055" = '*')
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM legalities AS T2
        WHERE T2."XCL_086" = T1."XCL_072"
          AND T2."XCL_084" = 'commander'
          AND T2."XCL_085" = 'Legal'
    )
